plain: A researcher named Jeffrey Drum tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a trip he says he made in the 2020s to the Giza Plateau in Egypt, where the great pyramids stand. He says he went to investigate the area around the Osiris Shaft, a deep shaft cut into the plateau. In the same interview he says he went right after a conference in Malta, as soon as they got back, and he credits someone named Alexa. He also says extra shafts were found near the causeway, the old raised road on the plateau. Drum is the only teller, describing it twice in one conversation, and it connects to his other claims about water from the shaft and the pyramid making sulfuric acid. He tells it because, as the episode puts it, it would point to a large energy system beneath the pyramids.
